projectName: Discord Quiz Bot - Student Progress Backup

userStories.title: Create directory structure and configure gitignore
userStories.description: Set up the backup module directory structure and ensure credentials are excluded from version control
acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/backup/ directory with __init__.py
Create credentials/ directory at project root
Add credentials/.gitignore with patterns: *.json, token.json
Update root .gitignore to exclude credentials/*.json
Verify git status shows credentials/ as ignored
userStories.notes: Foundation step. Must complete before OAuth setup.

userStories.title: Add Google Sheets API dependencies
userStories.description: Install required Python packages for Google Sheets and OAuth authentication
acceptanceCriteria: Add google-auth ^2.27.0 to pyproject.toml dependencies
Add google-auth-oauthlib ^1.2.0 to pyproject.toml dependencies
Add google-api-python-client ^2.116.0 to pyproject.toml dependencies
Add gspread ^6.0.0 to pyproject.toml dependencies
Run uv sync successfully
Verify imports: python -c 'import gspread; import google.auth' succeeds
userStories.notes: Use uv package manager. Add to [project.dependencies] section in pyproject.toml.

userStories.title: Add backup configuration to config.yaml
userStories.description: Configure backup settings in the bot's config file
acceptanceCriteria: Add backup.google_sheets section to config.yaml
Set credentials_file: credentials/google_oauth_credentials.json
Set token_file: credentials/token.json
Add OAuth scopes: spreadsheets and drive.file
Create .env.example with OAuth setup instructions
Config loads without errors on bot startup
userStories.notes: Follow existing config.yaml structure. See llm section for reference.

userStories.title: Implement Google Sheets OAuth client
userStories.description: Create client for Google Sheets API with OAuth 2.0 authentication flow
acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/backup/google_sheets_client.py
Implement OAuth 2.0 desktop flow with browser authentication
Implement token persistence to credentials/token.json
Implement automatic token refresh
Add create_spreadsheet(title: str) method returning spreadsheet ID
Add get_spreadsheet(spreadsheet_id: str) method
Add write_sheet(spreadsheet_id, sheet_name, data: List[List]) method
Add read_sheet(spreadsheet_id, sheet_name) method returning List[List]
Add list_spreadsheets(query: str) method
Add error handling for API failures and permission errors
Unit tests pass with mocked Google API
userStories.notes: Use gspread library. Follow google-auth-oauthlib patterns for OAuth. See existing async patterns in chibi/llm/.

userStories.title: Implement SQLite to Google Sheets exporter
userStories.description: Create exporter to read SQLite tables and write to Google Sheets
acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/backup/sheets_exporter.py with SheetsExporter class
Implement export_to_sheets() returning Dict with url and summary
Read all rows from users, quiz_attempts, concept_mastery, llm_quiz_attempts, attendance tables
Convert SQLite rows to list of lists format for Sheets API
Handle data type conversions: None to empty string, 0/1 to TRUE/FALSE
Truncate long text fields to 50,000 characters
Create spreadsheet named 'Chibi Student Progress - YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'
Create 6 sheets: Metadata, Users, QuizAttempts, ConceptMastery, LLMQuizAttempts, Attendance
Write data in batches of 1000 rows to respect rate limits
Unit tests verify data transformation correctness
All existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Use async/await. Follow pattern in chibi/database/repositories/. Test with in-memory database.

userStories.title: Implement Google Sheets to SQLite importer
userStories.description: Create importer to read Google Sheets and write to SQLite database
acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/backup/sheets_importer.py with SheetsImporter class
Implement import_from_sheets(spreadsheet_url, mode='replace') returning Dict
Extract spreadsheet ID from URL or use as-is if already an ID
Validate Metadata sheet exists and schema version matches
Validate all 5 data sheets exist with correct column headers
Convert Sheets data back to SQLite row dicts
Handle data type conversions: empty string to None, TRUE/FALSE to 1/0
Implement 'replace' mode: DELETE FROM all tables, INSERT new rows in transaction
Implement 'merge' mode: INSERT OR REPLACE for each row in transaction
Add rollback on error (atomic operation)
Unit tests verify schema validation and both import modes
All existing tests pass
userStories.notes: Use SQLite transactions. Test rollback behavior. See database/connection.py for transaction patterns.

userStories.title: Implement backup service orchestration
userStories.description: Create service layer to orchestrate export and import operations
acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/backup/backup_service.py with BackupService class
Initialize GoogleSheetsClient, SheetsExporter, SheetsImporter in __init__
Implement async export_progress() returning Dict with url and summary
Implement async import_progress(spreadsheet_url, mode) returning Dict
Implement async list_recent_exports(limit=10) returning List[Dict]
Add logging for all operations using existing logger
Add error handling with user-friendly error messages
Unit tests verify orchestration with mocked dependencies
All existing tests pass

acceptanceCriteria: Create chibi/cogs/backup_cog.py with BackupCog class
Implement /export-progress command with @commands.has_permissions(administrator=True)
Show ephemeral 'Exporting...' message, call export_progress(), show result with link
Implement /import-progress <spreadsheet_url> [mode] command with admin check
Add confirmation prompt for replace mode imports

Implement /list-exports command with admin check
Format exports as embed with clickable links
Handle errors with user-friendly messages
Integration tests verify commands with mocked interactions
All existing tests pass

userStories.title: Integrate BackupService and BackupCog into bot
userStories.description: Register backup components in the main bot class
acceptanceCriteria: Import BackupService and BackupCog in chibi/bot.py
Initialize BackupService in ChibiBot.__init__ with database and config
Register BackupCog in setup_hook or existing cog registration section
Bot starts without errors

userStories.title: Write unit tests for sheets exporter
userStories.description: Test SQLite to Sheets data transformation

Use in-memory SQLite database (:memory:) with test data
Mock GoogleSheetsClient
Test export with 2-3 users, quiz attempts, mastery records
Verify data transformation: SQLite rows to Sheets format
Verify data type conversions: None, bool, timestamps

acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/test_sheets_importer.py
Mock GoogleSheetsClient with realistic Sheets data
Test schema validation: valid and invalid schemas

userStories.title: Write unit tests for backup service

Test export_progress orchestration

Test list_recent_exports

Coverage >80% for chibi/backup/: uv run pytest tests/test_backup_*.py --cov=chibi/backup

userStories.title: Write integration tests for full backup cycle
userStories.description: End-to-end test of export and import with data integrity verification
acceptanceCriteria: Create tests/integration/test_backup_integration.py
Use in-memory SQLite with full schema
Mock Google Sheets API with realistic responses
Create fixture: 3 users, 10 quiz attempts, 5 mastery records
Test: export to Sheets, verify all data present
Test: export, clear database, import with replace, verify data restored
Test: export with 2 users, add 1 user, import with merge, verify 3 users
Verify referential integrity maintained (foreign keys)
Verify data types preserved
All tests pass: uv run pytest tests/integration/test_backup_integration.py -v

metadata.description: Export and import student learning progress data to/from Google Sheets for cross-machine portability and data recovery. Uses OAuth authentication and admin-only access.
metadata.notes: Start with foundation stories (US-001 to US-003) to set up structure. Core implementation (US-004 to US-009) builds the functionality. Testing stories (US-010 to US-014) ensure quality. Manual E2E testing with real Google Sheets API required after Ralph completes.
